---
name: setup-review
description: Guided first-time setup for the review kit, corporate network and optional integrations.
argument-hint: "[preset=path/to/company.json]"
agent: Review Setup Manager
---

Run the Review Setup Manager in setup mode. Ask simple questions, detect existing settings/tools first, and save only confirmed non-secret choices. A corporate preset supplies defaults, not credentials or commands. Do not run audits, upload reports or install dependencies during this setup command.
